mechanism: Tazarotene is a potent retinoid that can cause teratogenicity and photosensitivity; concurrent use with candesartan (also teratogenic) increases reproductive risk, and both agents may potentiate photosensitivity reactions.
action: Avoid combination in females of childbearing potential; if essential, ensure effective contraception with tazarotene and monitor for cumulative photosensitivity; counsel on sun protection.
